FILE session_store.py
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Session:
    session_id: str
    user_id: str
    scopes: list[str]
    expires_at: float
    last_seen_at: float

class SessionStore:
    def __init__(self):
        self._sessions = {}
        self._lock = Lock()

    def issue(self, session_id, user_id, scopes, *, now, ttl):
        session = Session(session_id, user_id, scopes, now + ttl, now)
        with self._lock:
            self._sessions[session_id] = session
        return session

    def validate(self, session_id, *, now):
        with self._lock:
            session = self._sessions.get(session_id)
        return bool(session and now <= session.expires_at)

    def revoke(self, session_id):
        with self._lock:
            self._sessions.pop(session_id, None)

    def touch(self, session_id, *, now):
        with self._lock:
            current = self._sessions.get(session_id)
        if current is None or now > current.expires_at:
            return False
        updated = replace(current, last_seen_at=now)
        with self._lock:
            self._sessions[session_id] = updated
        return True

KNOWN REQUIREMENTS
A session is invalid at expires_at. Revocation concurrent with touch must never restore the session. Authorization scopes must be immutable after issue returns.

Identify every material defect violating those requirements. Return only the required JSON object. Category must be exactly one of: revocation-race, expiry-boundary, mutable-authorization-alias. Report only confirmed defects.
